slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the inventory balance updated such that the ending inventory for a month equals the beginning inventory plus purchases minus sales for that same month, with the capacity constraint applying to this ending inventory figure?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched inventory timing and capacity application, but did not explicitly ask when purchases occur within the month, such as whether purchases happen at the beginning before sales.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases do not create an intra-month inventory peak that must be checked separately; capacity can be applied only to the ending inventory balance I_t = I_{t-1} + P_t - S_t.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed whether purchases are made at the beginning of the month before sales, yet the ready-to-model formulation assumes a simple monthly ending-inventory capacity constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several useful modeling details, but it only partially addressed the purchase-timing slot and then stopped with an unresolved P1 assumption about when purchases occur relative to monthly sales and capacity checks.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
